title: The Missing Ring, Part 1
description: The Missing Ring, Part 1 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Nelly Virago

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to Level 2 of MutantMania and locate the missing caravan. Search through it for clues and bring them back to Nelly Virago in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Nelly Virago

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: The Missing Ring, Part 2

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to Level 2 of MutantMania and locate the missing caravan. Search through it for clues and bring them back to Nelly Virago in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

Nelly Virago, here. Ace reporter for MutantMania Monthly Magazine. You're a new competitor in the MutantMania, aren't you? What's your name? My readers have the right to know! ...Really? That's it? Well, if that's the name you're sticking with....

Next topic: Are you helping with that All-Amateur Assault Polyhedral Circle Pan-Community Project Committee? What? You've never heard of the AAAPCPCPC before? That's disappointing. Maybe there isn't any story here, after all. Well, except that the AAAPCPCPC's caravan transporting the project's materials was recently hijacked.

...Now, if you were to go and collect all the missing materials, THAT would be a story worth my reader's time! I mean readers' time. If you want my educated opinion, you should go to MutantMania's Level 2 and look through the remains of the caravan. Let me know if you find any clues. Who knows...if you help recover the missing materials, you could become front page news! Or if you die. Either way, I'll have a good human interest piece.

Turn-in:

So you brought back a clue from the missing AAAPCPCPC caravan, eh? Good job. I know some people who know some people that can swing some science at it and crack open its fleshy secrets. There's not enough of a story here...yet. Come back later. I'll update you after I get a better understanding of the bigger picture.

Objectives:

  • A Clue ×1

Level range: 80–100
